pack.title: Networking events
pack.description: Keep a professional boundary while offering an appropriate route.

scenarios.setting: Someone wants to turn a casual introduction into an immediate unpaid consultation.
scenarios.jab: Can I just pick your brain for an hour sometime?
scenarios.goal: Keep a professional boundary while offering an appropriate route.

replies.line: For detailed advice, I book consultations. I can send the details.
replies.why: It clarifies the professional format without treating the request as an insult.
replies.delivery: Keep the offer warm and concrete; don't apologize for charging for your work.

replies.why: It identifies the appropriate service rather than agreeing to undefined free work.
replies.delivery: Keep the offer warm and concrete; don't apologize for charging for your work.

replies.line: I'd be happy to send my consultation details so you can decide whether it's a fit.
replies.why: It offers a useful next step without committing your time prematurely.
replies.delivery: Keep the offer warm and concrete; don't apologize for charging for your work.

replies.line: My brain has a booking calendar; I'll send the link.
replies.why: Playful wording makes the professional boundary approachable.
replies.delivery: Keep the offer warm and concrete; don't apologize for charging for your work.

followUp.line: A quick hello is fine; an hour of advice is a consultation.
followUp.why: It distinguishes social connection from the substantial professional request.
followUp.delivery: Keep the offer warm and concrete; don't apologize for charging for your work.
